text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: redis-kv-cache-error rate > 200/s in us-west-2 for service=runtime-gateway (pg: cache-miss storm) — paging eng-oncall
mike (eng-oncall): seeing it. dashboards show 5xx spike and token latency jump. taking it.
ana: I'm grabbing leader sh; taking lead for mitigation. can someone confirm customer impact? Jamie?
jamie (prod): small set of customers reporting slow responses and degraded completions; critical tier customers seeing retries from SDK. not full outage but elevated error rate ~3% for inference calls.
ana: thanks. initial hypothesis: KV eviction churn + transient network flaps causing prefix cache misses and high egress to redis. possible hot keys from recent rollout.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20251010-1183. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/INC-20251010-1183
mike (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) enable degraded-mode bypass for prefix cache on gateway (local fallback), 2) throttle background KV refreshers, 3) roll back last config change to routing weights (if confirmed).
ana: executing step 1 now: toggling `runtime.gateway.cache.prefix_bypass = true` on canary nodes. command: ```kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/gateway CANARY_CACHE_BYPASS=true``` doing a rolling restart for canary pods.
mike (eng-oncall): adding temporary rate-limit on public path `/v1/generate` for non-critical tiers to reduce load: `ratelimit rule add public_nginx /v1/generate 100r/s` (will revert in 30m)
jamie (prod): confirmed that two enterprise customers (acme-inc, betaapp) hit increased latency; logged CS tickets, telling them we're mitigating and will follow up.
sara (pm): tagging account execs for acme-inc; please add timeline when we have stable mitigation.
ana: canary cache bypass applied. metrics: cache hit rate down (expected) but 5xx errors dropping from 250/s -> 40/s in 4m. latency median improving.
mike (eng-oncall): great. holding to observe 10 mins. If stable, we'll promote to all nodes.
ana: promoting to all runtime gateway pods now. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n runtime` (progressing)
ops-bot: DeployBot: rollout completed for deployment/gateway in runtime namespace.
mike (eng-oncall): 5xx now ~12/s and trending down. opening post-incident follow-up thread for root cause and runbook changes.
ana: immediate mitigation done. next steps: assign RCA, schedule postmortem meeting, and update runbook with a checklist for cache-churn incidents.
jamie (prod): RCA candidate: recent traffic shaping experiment deployed yesterday changed routing_weights for a small cohort -> increased hot key concentration. need to validate with A/B config history.
sara (pm): propose postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00am PST. invite SRE, runtime, product, and CS. Agenda: timeline, root cause evidence, remediation plan, action owner assignments.
mike (eng-oncall): ok tentative schedule +1 day. I'll set calendar and create postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/INC-20251010-1183.
ana: immediate action items (from tonight):
- (A1) add guardrail to routing config deploys that detects hot-key skew and prevent >20% weight change per rollout — owner: ana — due: 2025-10-17
- (A2) add automated canary metric: prefix_hotkey_ratio and alert when >0.15 for 5m — owner: mike — due: 2025-10-14
- (A3) add step in on-call runbook: toggle gateway prefix_bypass and where to find the env toggle/command — owner: jamie — due: 2025-10-12
- (A4) update customer communications template for degraded performance events — owner: sara — due: 2025-10-13
- (A5) post-deploy verification: run a synthetic hot-key scan for 30m after routing changes — owner: eng-runtime team (TBD) — due: 2025-10-20
jamie (prod): I'll take A3 and coordinate with docs.
mike (eng-oncall): I'll own A2; will add metric and add alert to Alertmanager (rule id: AM-rca-redis-01)
ana: I'll take A1; will add pre-deploy validation in config service + blocklist for rapid weight changes.
sara (pm): I'll own A4 and draft the template; CS review in 48h.
ops-bot: Action created: INC-20251010-1183-A1 assigned to ana, due 2025-10-17
ops-bot: Action created: INC-20251010-1183-A2 assigned to mike, due 2025-10-14
ops-bot: Action created: INC-20251010-1183-A3 assigned to jamie, due 2025-10-12
ops-bot: Action created: INC-20251010-1183-A4 assigned to sara, due 2025-10-13
ops-bot: Action created: INC-20251010-1183-A5 assigned to eng-runtime (placeholder), due 2025-10-20
mike (eng-oncall): runbook changes: propose new section under "KV cache and hot-key incidents":
```
- detect: prefix_hotkey_ratio alert
- mitigate: set CANARY_CACHE_BYPASS=true on gateway; throttle background refreshers; add non-critical-tier rate limit
- rollback: revert routing weight changes for last deploy
- verify: 30m stable 5xx < 1% and median latency within baseline
```
ana: also add a note to check `model-routing-config` PRs for sudden weight moves in review checklist.
jamie (prod): one more operational tweak: make the cache-bypass toggle available as a runbook play in Console (fast button) — ops ticket created: OPS-2344
sara (pm): for customer messaging: timeline template + diagnosis + what we're doing + ETA for fix + contact link. keep it short.
mike (eng-oncall): OK will create postmortem doc and link actions. we should schedule an hour review with slides and the timeline from logs.
ana: logs snapshot commands for postmortem: ```pgrep -a gateway || true; kubectl logs -l app=gateway --since=2h | grep prefix_cache || true``` add KV server query: ```redis-cli -h redis-usw2 info keyspace```
jamie (prod): CS notes: escalate acme-inc to priority follow-up and offer postmortem recap call after RCA.
sara (pm): noted. I'll prepare invite and link to doc once mike creates it.
mike (eng-oncall): last call: any objections to closing incident and marking as mitigated? 5xx back to baseline and alerts suppressed.
ana: no objections. closing incident in 10m and will reopen if regressions.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20251010-1183 status updated -> mitigated by ana at 2025-10-10T21:30:00Z
mike (eng-oncall): thanks everyone. Postmortem draft expected by EOD tomorrow; meeting invite sent.
jamie (prod): (reaction :thumbsup:)
sara (pm): (reaction :white_check_mark:)
